label: Voltage Regulator (v-reg dpack)
description: Voltage Regulator Standard LM317 adjustable voltage regulator. AOI (Adjust Output Input). Google 'LM317 Calculator' for easy to use app to get the two resistor values needed. 240/720 for 5V output. 240/390 for 3.3V output. Spark Fun Electronics SKU : COM-00527
